My favorite crew : Can You Guess the Characters?

You know how hard it can be to picture a beloved character when reading a book, right? I’ve definitely had my share of mental blocks, and I often end up searching for fan art to help bring them to life. (Though, I’ll admit, I’ve accidentally spoiled a few surprises doing that in the past!)

Fortunately, the fan art I’m sharing below is spoiler-free, and I’m thrilled to introduce you to one of my favorite cozy sci-fi space crews. Can you match each character with their description? Just a heads-up, the descriptions come from the books, but these fan arts are the artists’ interpretations—so they’re not 100% true to the text.

In my favorite piece, Cain has a beard, Robin is wearing his glasses, and Marirose is in a yellow top.

I’ve changed the characters’ names so that, put in the correct order, they reveal the name of their author.

Arzt
  • Balloon-like cheeks
  • six limbs
  • Wears a short-sleeve shirt with a green logo and pants
Elsix
  • Lithe and lean, with moss green scales fading into a paler shade over her belly
  • No nose, no lips, no ears
  • Multicolored feathered mane
Heloïse
  • Black hair tied in a bun with a ribbon
  • Wears an orange jumpsuit
  • Hasty handwritten notes scribbled on the sleeves
Robin
  • Practically pink
  • Male
San
  • Walks on all fours with long fingers
  • Back bowed, covered in ice-blue fur
  • Enormous, long-lashed wet eyes
Cain
  • Small and stocky
  • Side of his head shaved, with a tuft of curls atop his scalp
  • Tatoos and piercings
Bobby
  • Tight black curls
  • Amber skin
Marirose
  • Copper skin, lighter than Cain
  • A head smaller than Elsix
  • Curly brown hair

Wayfarers

Auteur : Becky Chambers

the Wayfarers series by Becky Chambers follows a crew aboard the spaceship Wayfarer, navigating the vastness of space and diverse cultures. This character-driven cosy sci-fi focuses on relationships, acceptance, and coexistence, rather than traditional space conflicts, offering a warm and hopeful view of future societies.

  • The Long Way to a Small, Angry Planet
  • A Closed and Common Orbit
  • Record of a Spaceborn Few

  • The Galaxy, and the Ground Within

  • Winner of the 2019 Hugo Award for Best Series

Becky Chambers’s website : http://www.otherscribbles.com
